name: Sunken Treasure
summary: In Sunken Treasure, Shakes O'Breen is held back by the low tide and watchful creatures, so word must reach Booty Bay.

sections.title: Word for Booty Bay
sections.body: Shakes O'Breen needs Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay to hear of the find at once. The tide is too low for him to leave, and the creatures his crew disturbed watch every move. He asks you to tell Seahorn the treasure has been found and more is being brought up. You carry a sample elven gem as proof.

faq.q: Why can't Shakes O'Breen deliver the gem himself?
aliases: why does shakes need a courier
faq.answer: The tide is too low for Shakes O'Breen and his crew to leave, and the creatures they disturbed watch their movements.
Fleet Master Seahorn is in Booty Bay, and O'Breen wants him to hear of the find at once.

faq.q: What proof is being carried to Booty Bay?
faq.answer: You carry a sample elven gem to prove the treasure was found and more is being brought up.
